design:
Child of the multi-thermo flowsheet epic (bn op-186o).


**Changing package and changing component resolution are different
operations.** Keep them architecturally separate even if the flowsheet composes
them automatically.

- `PR -> SRK` — same component inventory, thermo change only
- `CDU TBP40 pseudocomponents -> hydrotreater reaction lumps` — representation
  change, possibly with a thermo change
- `molecular H2S/CO2/H2O -> reactive amine speciation` — derived basis

Coordinate with the conservative-lumping architecture (#79) rather than
building a parallel mechanism: both are representation changes that must
preserve conserved quantities.

Must retain **provenance** describing how the destination representation was
obtained, and report reconstruction error where defined (TBP RMS, MW, density,
SARA deviation).

**Do not require the CDU to solve thousands of molecular components merely
because the canonical stream carries higher-information characterization.**


## Constraints

Mature-crate refactor: preserve public constructors, deprecate rather than remove, regression tests before semantic changes. Do not implement AGR/Claus/the refinery here. `develop` only, no push to `main`.
title: MultiThermo: RepresentationBridge integration
